videos.title: The Sky Economy
videos.description:
What is the low-altitude economy, and how is it transforming transport, logistics, and smart cities? 

In this introductory lesson, we break down what the Low-Altitude Economy (LAE) means, why airspace below 1,000 meters is becoming a multi-billion-dollar frontier, and how emerging technologies like delivery drones and eVTOL flying taxis are already taking flight across the Greater Bay Area and beyond.

---

What’s covered in this video:
- Defining the Low-Altitude Economy (LAE): Airspace below 1,000 meters
- Commercial Airspace vs. Low-Altitude Zone: Why low altitude suits short, fast trips
- Real-World Drone Delivery: How platforms like Meituan cut delivery times in Shenzhen
- Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL): Quiet, green flying taxis connecting cities
- Beyond Deliveries: Agricultural crop spraying, emergency medicine delivery, and firefighting
- Greater Bay Area & Hong Kong: Market potential and infrastructure growth

---

---

videos.description:
Drones are far more than just delivery tools—they are intelligent flying robots transforming industries and pushing the boundaries of modern technology.

In this lesson, we break down what makes Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) work, compare multi-rotor vs. fixed-wing designs, explore cutting-edge sensors and autonomous flight, and examine real-world use cases from site surveying and environmental monitoring to search-and-rescue missions and drone racing.

videos.title: What is skewness? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 11/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/8uYMgpdsbAs
Next: https://youtu.be/ChJ7XioOhbo
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is skewness?

Two shops both total 500 cups over five days, average 100. Shop A: 70, 80, 90, 100, 160 - three days below 100, one rush at 160. Shop B is the mirror: 40, 100, 110, 120, 130. Prep 100 at A wastes on three days; at B you run short on three. Same average and same variance (1,000) cannot tell them apart.

Skewness uses cubed gaps so the sign survives. A's sum of cubes is +180,000; standardized skewness about +1.1 (right / long high side). B is about -1.1. It names which side is long - not better/worse, and not how many cups to prep by itself.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是偏度？

两家店五天合计都是500杯，平均100。A店：70、80、90、100、160 - 三天低于100，一天高峰160。B店是镜像：40、100、110、120、130。按100备货，A店三天浪费，B店三天短缺。相同平均、相同方差（1,000）分不开它们。

偏度用三次方差距，符号能留下来。A的立方和是+180,000；标准化偏度约+1.1（右偏 / 高端更长）。B约-1.1。它指出哪一侧更长 - 不是更好/更差，也不能单独决定备多少杯。

videos.title: What is kurtosis? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 12/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/dgh99RbB43s
Next: https://youtu.be/u5qu_Cuk0UA
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is kurtosis?

Two shops average 100 with the same variance and zero skewness, but different tails. Shop A: 52, 64, 100, 136, 148 - moderate misses of 36-48 on four days. Shop B: 40, 100, 100, 100, 160 - spot on three days, then off by 60 twice. A steady buffer covers A more often; B fails on the rare far days.

Kurtosis weighs the fourth power of the gaps - higher means heavier tails. A is about 1.3; B is 2.5. Myth: peakedness - read tails, not how pointy the middle looks. A Normal benchmark is 3; excess kurtosis is kurtosis minus 3. It does not say how many reserve cups to hold by itself.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 12 (kurtosis)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是峰度？

两家店平均都是100，方差相同、偏度为零，但尾巴不同。A店：52、64、100、136、148 - 四天偏差约36-48。B店：40、100、100、100、160 - 三天正好，两天各偏60。稳定缓冲更能覆盖A；B会在少见的远天上失手。

峰度看差距的四次方 - 越高尾巴越重。A约1.3；B是2.5。误区：尖峰 - 要读尾巴，不是中间有多尖。正态基准是3；超额峰度=峰度-3。它本身不告诉你备多少杯。

videos.title: What is covariance? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 13/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/ChJ7XioOhbo
Next: https://youtu.be/7JHO74rUbqM
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is covariance?

Five shops: rents 10,000, 12,000, 13,000, 16,000, 19,000 (average 14,000) and cups 300, 330, 360, 400, 460 (average 370). For each shop, (rent - 14,000) x (cups - 370). All five products are positive; sum 880,000; share by 5: covariance = 176,000 dollar-cups. Positive means when rent is above average, cups tend to be too.

Rewrite rent in cents and the number becomes 17,600,000 - same shops, different unit. Read the sign as direction of linear co-movement. Do not read raw size as strength, and do not treat covariance as proof that rent causes sales.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 13 (covariance)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是协方差？

五家店：租金10,000、12,000、13,000、16,000、19,000（平均14,000），杯数300、330、360、400、460（平均370）。每家算（租金-14,000）x（杯数-370）。五个乘积都为正；合计880,000；除以5：协方差=176,000美元-杯。为正表示租金偏高时，杯数也往往偏高。

改写成美分，数字变成17,600,000 - 店没变，单位变了。把符号读成线性同向/反向。不要把绝对大小当成强度，也不要把协方差当成租金导致销量的证明。

videos.title: What is correlation? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 14/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/u5qu_Cuk0UA
Next: https://youtu.be/wEEc_1uirK8
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is correlation?

Same five shops as the covariance short: rents 10k-19k and cups 300-460. Covariance is 176,000 dollar-cups. Divide by (rent SD x cups SD): about 3,162 x 55.9 ≈ 176,750. Correlation r ≈ 176,000 / 176,750 ≈ +0.996, about +1.00.

r sits on a unit-free scale from -1 to +1. Near +1 is a strong positive linear pattern; near -1 the opposite. Switch rent to cents and r stays about +1.00. Strong together-movement is still not proof that raising rent raises cups.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 14 (correlation)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是相关系数？

与协方差短片相同的五家店：租金1万到1.9万，杯数300到460。协方差是176,000美元-杯。除以（租金标准差 x 杯数标准差）：约3,162 x 55.9 ≈ 176,750。相关系数 r ≈ 176,000 / 176,750 ≈ +0.996，约+1.00。

r 在无单位的 -1 到 +1 尺上。靠近+1是强正线性形态；靠近-1则相反。租金改成美分，r仍约+1.00。一起动得强，仍不是“提高租金就能提高销量”的证明。

videos.title: What is a decision dashboard? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 15/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/7JHO74rUbqM
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is a decision dashboard?

One Monday file: Shop A 310, Shop B 420, Shop C 4,200. The average is pulled by C; the middle shop is 420; end to end is 3,890 cups. Each answers a different question. A decision dashboard is the four dials from the opening short on one board: center, spread, shape, and association.

Pair the dial the decision asks with a matching measure (in this module variance/SD divide by n). Shape uses skewness, kurtosis, and outlier fences as review flags - not automatic proof of error. Association needs a second column (rent beside cups): covariance 176,000 dollar-cups and r about +1.00 still do not prove cause. Name the dial, the shops, period, and unit, then write the limitation before you act.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 15 (recap)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是决策仪表盘？

一份星期一文件：A店310、B店420、C店4,200。平均数被C拉高；中间店是420；两端差3,890杯。每个数回答不同问题。决策仪表盘就是开篇四个刻度做成一块板：中心、离散、形态、关联。

决策问哪个刻度，就配相应度量（本模块方差/标准差除以n）。形态用偏度、峰度和异常篱笆做复查标记 - 不是自动证明录入错误。关联需要第二列（租金配杯数）：协方差176,000美元-杯、r约+1.00仍不能证明因果。行动前先点名刻度、店铺、时期和单位，并写上限度。

videos.title: What is the median? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 03/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/SOEspMMSKBY
Next: https://youtu.be/hUU36S5g_YE
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is the median?

Shop A has five Monday-to-Friday style days: 80, 100, 120, 140, and one rush at 460. The average is 900 / 5 = 180 cups. Set 180 as the typical-day target and four ordinary days (80 to 140) all miss it. Only the rush clears it.

The median answers a different question: what does a typical day sell? Sort low to high and read the middle. With five days the middle place is the third: 120 cups. That sits among the quiet days. Grow the rush from 460 to 4,000 and the average jumps, but the median stays 120 - it uses place in the queue, not how far the rush sticks out.

Shop B has four days: 100, 200, 300, 800. No single middle place, so share the two middles: (200 + 300) / 2 = 250. Odd count: read one middle. Even count: average the two middle values.

The median is robust to a rush day, and it works for ranked answers (poor, fair, good, very good, excellent) where you cannot add the words. It still hides the total and the rush - keep the raw days in view when planning stock.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 3 (median)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是中位数？

A店有五天杯数：80、100、120、140，以及一天高峰460。平均数是 900 / 5 = 180杯。把180当成典型日目标，四天普通日（80到140）全部达不到，只有高峰日过线。

中位数回答另一个问题：典型的一天卖多少？从小到大排好，读中间那个。五天时中间是第三位：120杯，落在安静的几天里。把高峰从460改成4,000，平均数会飙升，中位数仍是120 - 它看的是队列里的位置，不是高峰拉多远。

B店有四天：100、200、300、800。没有单独的正中间，就平分两个中间值：(200 + 300) / 2 = 250。奇数个：读一个中间；偶数个：把两个中间值平均。

中位数对高峰日稳健，也适用于只能排序的答案（差、一般、好、很好、优秀），那些词加不起来。它仍会藏起总数和高峰 - 备货时还要看着原始天数。

videos.title: What are variance and standard deviation? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 08/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/xAuvBFbeaBc
Next: https://youtu.be/81ByekINlqw
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What are variance and standard deviation?

Two shops both average 365 cups over five days (1,825 / 5). Shop A: 300, 330, 365, 400, 430 - swings about 65 either side. Shop B: 350, 360, 365, 370, 380 - stays within 15. Same average, different staffing plan.

Signed gaps from 365 cancel to zero, so we square them. For A the sum of squares is 10,900; share by 5: variance = 2,180 square cups. Standard deviation is the square root, about 47 cups. Shop B: variance 100, SD = 10. SD uses every day and speaks in cups - it is not an order to add 47 staff cups by itself.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 8 (variance and SD)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是方差和标准差？

两家店五天平均都是365杯（1,825 / 5）。A店：300、330、365、400、430 - 大约上下摆65。B店：350、360、365、370、380 - 留在15以内。平均数相同，人手计划不同。

相对365的带符号差距加总为零，所以要平方。A店平方和10,900；除以5：方差=2,180平方杯。标准差是开方，约47杯。B店：方差100，标准差=10。标准差用上每一天，单位是杯 - 它本身不是“多加47杯人手”的订单。

videos.title: What is descriptive statistics? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 01/15
Next: https://youtu.be/SOEspMMSKBY
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is descriptive statistics?

A Monday coffee file lands with three shops: Shop A sold 310 cups, Shop B sold 420, and Shop C sold 4,200. Copy the busiest row and you over-order milk. Copy the quietest and the busy shop runs dry. Raw rows alone do not manage a chain.

This short names the toolkit that turns that file into a decision: descriptive statistics. Before any summary, ask four dials on the same file:

- Center - where a typical shop sits
- Spread - how wide the line runs
- Shape - which side is long (here the high end stretches far: 4,200 - 310 = 3,890 cups)
- Association - whether two measures move together (cups alone are not enough; pair cups with something like monthly rent)

One Monday row or one number is not four answers. Name the dial, the shops, and the unit before you trust a summary. These dials condense the file you have - they do not by themselves set staffing, inventory, or prices.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 1 (intro)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是描述性统计？

一份周一咖啡文件落到桌上：A店卖出310杯，B店420杯，C店4,200杯。照搬最忙的一行，你会多订牛奶；照搬最闲的一行，忙店午饭前就会断货。原始行本身管不了连锁店。

本短片讲的工具包，就是把这份文件变成决策的描述性统计。动手汇总之前，先对同一份文件问四个刻度：

- 中心 - 典型门店落在哪里
- 离散 - 这条线有多宽
- 形态 - 哪一侧更长（这里高端拉得很远：4,200 - 310 = 3,890杯）
- 关联 - 两个量是否一起动（只有杯数不够；要把杯数和例如月租配成一对）

用周一的一行或一个数，回答不了四个刻度。信任任何摘要之前，先点名刻度、门店和单位。这些刻度压缩的是你手里的文件 - 它们本身不会定人手、库存或价格。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片1（导论）

videos.title: What is the mean? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 02/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/VS7Qbq07ATM
Next: https://youtu.be/dwzUsfaK5cE
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is the mean?

Head office wants one number for four coffee shops on Monday: Shop A sold 250 cups, Shop B 300, Shop C 350, and Shop D 500. Copy the busiest shop and the plan is 2,000 cups. Copy the quietest and it is 1,000. The four shops sold only 1,400 together.

The mean is the equal share of that total: add every cup count, then divide by how many shops. 250 + 300 + 350 + 500 = 1,400, and 1,400 / 4 = 350 cups. Four times 350 brings the total back. On a line, 350 is also the balance point: the signed gaps add to zero.

Use 350 for the group picture — not as each shop's own sales, and not as stock for every door. The midpoint of 250 and 500 is 375, not 350. Head office's one number: 350 cups.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 2 (mean)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是平均数？

总部要一个数代表四家咖啡店的星期一：A店卖出250杯，B店300杯，C店350杯，D店500杯。照抄最忙的店，计划变成2,000杯；照抄最清闲的店，又只有1,000杯。四家店加起来其实只卖了1,400杯。

平均数就是这个总数的平均份额：把每个杯数加起来，再除以有几家店。250 + 300 + 350 + 500 = 1,400，1,400 / 4 = 350杯。4乘350又回到总数。在一条线上，350也是平衡点：带符号的差距加起来等于零。

用350看整体——不是每家店各自的销量，也不能拿它给每家店都配货。250和500的中点是375，不是350。总部要的那一个数：350杯。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片2（平均数）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

videos.title: What is the mode? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 04/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/dwzUsfaK5cE
Next: https://youtu.be/3g6ScHOj2jI
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is the mode?

The factory asks which lid should get the largest run before Monday. You sell Small, Medium, and Large. Monday's orders: Small 40, Medium 280, Large 100. These are labels, not cups you can add - there is no average lid and no middle lid the plant can make.

Count how often each size appears. Medium's bar is tallest at 280, above Small at 40 and Large at 100. That most common value (or category) is the mode. Run Medium largest. Still stock Small and Large: together they still have 140 orders, and 280 is not a full lid order by itself.

Drawbacks: a second Monday with Small 40, Medium 150, Large 150 is bimodal - two modes share the top. Three orders of one each (1, 1, 1) means no mode. When every day differs - say 52, 64, 100, 136, 148 - group the days: Under 100 has two days, 100 to 150 has three. No day sold over 150, so that empty band stays off the chart. The modal class is 100 to 150.

Use the mode when labels cannot be added and you need the most common choice.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 4 (mode)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是众数？

工厂要问：星期一前哪一种杯盖该开最大一批？你卖小杯、中杯、大杯。星期一订单：小杯40、中杯280、大杯100。这些是标签，加不起来 - 没有工厂能做的“平均杯盖”，也没有正中间的杯盖。

数每种规格出现几次。中杯柱最高，280，高于小杯40和大杯100。出现次数最多的值（或类别）就是众数。中杯开最大一批。小杯和大杯仍要备：两边合计还有140单，而且280本身不是完整的杯盖订单。

注意：另一个星期一若是小杯40、中杯150、大杯150，就是双峰 - 两个众数并列最高。各一单（1、1、1）则没有众数。若每天都不同 - 例如52、64、100、136、148 - 就分组：100以下两天，100到150三天。没有一天超过150，空的那一组不画在图上。众数组是100到150。

标签加不起来、又要最常见选择时，用众数。

videos.title: What is the range? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 05/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/hUU36S5g_YE
Next: https://youtu.be/L3FeHWK2g-Q
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is the range?

Four shops average 370 cups on both Monday and Tuesday (1,480 / 4). Same average does not mean the same delivery. Monday: 380, 310, 420, 370. Sort and take max minus min: 420 - 310 = 110 cups. Send everyone 370 and Shop C is 50 short while Shop B has 60 left over. Tuesday: 360, 380, 350, 390. Range is 390 - 350 = 40 cups, so one size of 370 fits better.

The range is maximum minus minimum. It uses only the two ends - Monday skips 370 and 380 in the middle. Add Shop E, a 24-hour site at 4,200, and the range jumps to 4,200 - 310 = 3,890. Street shops alone stay at 110. Check the range before one truck size, and say which shops are included.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 5 (range)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是极差？

四家店星期一和星期二的平均数都是370杯（1,480 / 4）。平均数相同，送货计划未必相同。星期一：380、310、420、370。排序后最大减最小：420 - 310 = 110杯。每家都送370，C店短缺50，B店多出60。星期二：360、380、350、390。极差是390 - 350 = 40杯，一份370更合适。

极差就是最大值减最小值。它只用两端 - 星期一中间的370和380根本没用上。加上24小时店E的4,200杯，极差跳到4,200 - 310 = 3,890；只看街边店仍是110。统一配送前先看极差，并说清楚算进了哪些店。

videos.title: What is a percentile? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 06/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/3g6ScHOj2jI
Next: https://youtu.be/xAuvBFbeaBc
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is a percentile?

Head office wants strong shops to visit. Shop D sold 390 cups. Alone, 390 cannot say if that is strong. Five shops Monday: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. Average about 352 puts D only 38 above average. On the ordered line D is 4th of 5: 4 shops sit at or below 390, so 4 / 5 = 80%. 390 is the 80th percentile; Shop D's percentile rank is 80%.

To find the 80th: sort, 0.80 x 5 = 4, read place 4 = 390. For the 50th, 0.50 x 5 = 2.5 rounds up to place 3. Add Shop F above 420 and 4 of 6 at or below 390 is about 67%. A percentile is a place in line, not how far ahead. Report the group, period, and method.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 6 (percentile)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是百分位数？

总部想先拜访强店。D店卖了390杯。单看390说不出强不强。五家店星期一：360、420、280、390、310。平均数约352，D只高38。排序后D是第4/5名：4家在390及以下，4 / 5 = 80%。390是第80百分位数；D店的百分位秩是80%。

找第80：排序，0.80 x 5 = 4，读第4位=390。第50时，0.50 x 5 = 2.5向上取整到第3位。再加高于420的F店，4/6约67%。百分位数是队列位置，不是领先多少。要写明店铺组、时期和方法。

videos.title: What is the interquartile range? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 07/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/L3FeHWK2g-Q
Next: https://youtu.be/3ZG8bVDP35c
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is the interquartile range?

Head office wants a normal milk band for street shops, not a band set by the strangest day. Five shops: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. End to end is 420 - 280 = 140 cups. Sort: 280, 310, 360, 390, 420. Q1 (25th) at place 0.25 x 5 = 1.25 -＞ 2 is 310. Q3 (75th) at 0.75 x 5 = 3.75 -＞ 4 is 390. IQR = 390 - 310 = 80 cups - the width of the middle box.

Add Shop F at 4,200 and the ends stretch to 3,920, while the IQR only moves to about 110. The IQR is robust to a far shop but not immune, and it does not plan for the far day itself. Report group, period, and nearest-rank method.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 7 (IQR)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是四分位距？

总部要给街边店定一个正常牛奶带宽，不要被最怪的一天带跑。五家店：360、420、280、390、310。两端差420 - 280 = 140杯。排序：280、310、360、390、420。Q1（第25）在0.25 x 5 = 1.25 -＞ 2，是310。Q3（第75）在0.75 x 5 = 3.75 -＞ 4，是390。IQR = 390 - 310 = 80杯，就是中间盒子的宽度。

加上F店4,200杯，两端拉到3,920，IQR大约只到110。IQR对远店稳健但不是免疫，也不能单独给远店做计划。要写明店铺组、时期和最近秩方法。

videos.title: What is the coefficient of variation? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 09/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/3ZG8bVDP35c
Next: https://youtu.be/8uYMgpdsbAs
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is the coefficient of variation?

Shop A is small: about 300 cups a day, SD 30. Shop B is big: about 3,000 cups, SD 150. In raw cups B swings five times more. Relative to its own day, A is 30 / 300 = 10%, and B is 150 / 3,000 = 5%. For its size, A is the harder shop to plan.

CV = (standard deviation / average) x 100%, a unit-free percent - cups cancel. The same 10% can appear for dollars too. Watch tiny averages: CV can blow up. Use CV when shops differ in size and you need a fair share-of-swing comparison.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 9 (CV)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是变异系数？

A店小：一天大约300杯，标准差30。B店大：大约3,000杯，标准差150。按杯数算，B的摆幅大5倍。相对各自日销量，A是30 / 300 = 10%，B是150 / 3,000 = 5%。按规模看，A更难计划。

CV =（标准差 / 平均数）x 100%，是无单位的百分比 - 杯会约掉。美元也可以得到同样的10%。平均极小时CV会爆。店铺规模不同、又要公平比较摆幅占比时，用CV。

videos.title: What is an outlier? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M01 · Descriptive measures for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 10/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/81ByekINlqw
Next: https://youtu.be/dgh99RbB43s
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLU3qcXNMuV0A

What is an outlier?

Five street shops: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. Add Shop F at 4,200 - ten times Shop B's 420. Delete a real busy site and you understock; keep a typing slip and the average jumps from about 352 to about 993.

Fence rule: IQR of the five is 80. 1.5 x 80 = 120. Lower fence 310 - 120 = 190; upper 390 + 120 = 510. 4,200 sits 3,690 above the upper fence, so it is flagged. With six shops the fence moves but 4,200 is still flagged. A flag means check the story - typing slip, one-off Monday, or a different kind of shop - not automatic delete.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 10 (outlier)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

什么是异常值？

五家街边店：360、420、280、390、310。加上F店4,200 - 是B店420的十倍。删掉真忙的店会备货不足；留下打字多一个0，平均数大约从352跳到993。

篱笆规则：五家的IQR是80。1.5 x 80 = 120。下篱笆310 - 120 = 190；上篱笆390 + 120 = 510。4,200高出上篱笆3,690，被标出。六家时篱笆会动，但4,200仍被标出。标出是请你查故事 - 打字错误、异常星期一、或另一类店 - 不是自动删除。

videos.title: What is Skewness? (Voiceover: Mandarin · Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 11/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/Z9NGZIeHHMI
下一课：https://youtu.be/mvvq6Vq4BUs
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是偏度？

两家店五天合计都是500杯，平均100。A店：70、80、90、100、160 - 三天低于100，一天高峰160。B店是镜像：40、100、110、120、130。按100备货，A店三天浪费，B店三天短缺。相同平均、相同方差（1,000）分不开它们。

偏度用三次方差距，符号能留下来。A的立方和是+180,000；标准化偏度约+1.1（右偏 / 高端更长）。B约-1.1。它指出哪一侧更长 - 不是更好/更差，也不能单独决定备多少杯。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片11（偏度）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is skewness?

Two shops both total 500 cups over five days, average 100. Shop A: 70, 80, 90, 100, 160 - three days below 100, one rush at 160. Shop B is the mirror: 40, 100, 110, 120, 130. Prep 100 at A wastes on three days; at B you run short on three. Same average and same variance (1,000) cannot tell them apart.

Skewness uses cubed gaps so the sign survives. A's sum of cubes is +180,000; standardized skewness about +1.1 (right / long high side). B is about -1.1. It names which side is long - not better/worse, and not how many cups to prep by itself.

videos.title: What is Kurtosis?
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 12/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/IfZSkxjGnIo
下一课：https://youtu.be/j4YmVIemDOw
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是峰度？

两家店平均都是100，方差相同、偏度为零，但尾巴不同。A店：52、64、100、136、148 - 四天偏差约36-48。B店：40、100、100、100、160 - 三天正好，两天各偏60。稳定缓冲更能覆盖A；B会在少见的远天上失手。

峰度看差距的四次方 - 越高尾巴越重。A约1.3；B是2.5。误区：尖峰 - 要读尾巴，不是中间有多尖。正态基准是3；超额峰度=峰度-3。它本身不告诉你备多少杯。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片12（峰度）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is kurtosis?

Two shops average 100 with the same variance and zero skewness, but different tails. Shop A: 52, 64, 100, 136, 148 - moderate misses of 36-48 on four days. Shop B: 40, 100, 100, 100, 160 - spot on three days, then off by 60 twice. A steady buffer covers A more often; B fails on the rare far days.

Kurtosis weighs the fourth power of the gaps - higher means heavier tails. A is about 1.3; B is 2.5. Myth: peakedness - read tails, not how pointy the middle looks. A Normal benchmark is 3; excess kurtosis is kurtosis minus 3. It does not say how many reserve cups to hold by itself.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 12 (kurtosis)

videos.title: What Is Covariance? (Voiceover: Mandarin · Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 13/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/mvvq6Vq4BUs
下一课：https://youtu.be/V0UQL2e36Us
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是协方差？

五家店：租金10,000、12,000、13,000、16,000、19,000（平均14,000），杯数300、330、360、400、460（平均370）。每家算（租金-14,000）x（杯数-370）。五个乘积都为正；合计880,000；除以5：协方差=176,000美元-杯。为正表示租金偏高时，杯数也往往偏高。

改写成美分，数字变成17,600,000 - 店没变，单位变了。把符号读成线性同向/反向。不要把绝对大小当成强度，也不要把协方差当成租金导致销量的证明。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片13（协方差）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is covariance?

Five shops: rents 10,000, 12,000, 13,000, 16,000, 19,000 (average 14,000) and cups 300, 330, 360, 400, 460 (average 370). For each shop, (rent - 14,000) x (cups - 370). All five products are positive; sum 880,000; share by 5: covariance = 176,000 dollar-cups. Positive means when rent is above average, cups tend to be too.

Rewrite rent in cents and the number becomes 17,600,000 - same shops, different unit. Read the sign as direction of linear co-movement. Do not read raw size as strength, and do not treat covariance as proof that rent causes sales.

videos.title: What Is a Correlation Coefficient?
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 14/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/j4YmVIemDOw
下一课：https://youtu.be/SqLGIEixEhs
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是相关系数？

与协方差短片相同的五家店：租金1万到1.9万，杯数300到460。协方差是176,000美元-杯。除以（租金标准差 x 杯数标准差）：约3,162 x 55.9 ≈ 176,750。相关系数 r ≈ 176,000 / 176,750 ≈ +0.996，约+1.00。

r 在无单位的 -1 到 +1 尺上。靠近+1是强正线性形态；靠近-1则相反。租金改成美分，r仍约+1.00。一起动得强，仍不是“提高租金就能提高销量”的证明。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片14（相关系数）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is correlation?

Same five shops as the covariance short: rents 10k-19k and cups 300-460. Covariance is 176,000 dollar-cups. Divide by (rent SD x cups SD): about 3,162 x 55.9 ≈ 176,750. Correlation r ≈ 176,000 / 176,750 ≈ +0.996, about +1.00.

r sits on a unit-free scale from -1 to +1. Near +1 is a strong positive linear pattern; near -1 the opposite. Switch rent to cents and r stays about +1.00. Strong together-movement is still not proof that raising rent raises cups.

videos.title: What Is a Decision Dashboard?
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 15/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/V0UQL2e36Us
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是决策仪表盘？

一份星期一文件：A店310、B店420、C店4,200。平均数被C拉高；中间店是420；两端差3,890杯。每个数回答不同问题。决策仪表盘就是开篇四个刻度做成一块板：中心、离散、形态、关联。

决策问哪个刻度，就配相应度量（本模块方差/标准差除以n）。形态用偏度、峰度和异常篱笆做复查标记 - 不是自动证明录入错误。关联需要第二列（租金配杯数）：协方差176,000美元-杯、r约+1.00仍不能证明因果。行动前先点名刻度、店铺、时期和单位，并写上限度。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片15（回顾）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is a decision dashboard?

One Monday file: Shop A 310, Shop B 420, Shop C 4,200. The average is pulled by C; the middle shop is 420; end to end is 3,890 cups. Each answers a different question. A decision dashboard is the four dials from the opening short on one board: center, spread, shape, and association.

Pair the dial the decision asks with a matching measure (in this module variance/SD divide by n). Shape uses skewness, kurtosis, and outlier fences as review flags - not automatic proof of error. Association needs a second column (rent beside cups): covariance 176,000 dollar-cups and r about +1.00 still do not prove cause. Name the dial, the shops, period, and unit, then write the limitation before you act.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 15 (recap)

videos.title: What is the range? (Narration: Mandarin; Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 05/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/_T9_d_F6120
下一课：https://youtu.be/DH54xluCX2Y
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是极差？

四家店星期一和星期二的平均数都是370杯（1,480 / 4）。平均数相同，送货计划未必相同。星期一：380、310、420、370。排序后最大减最小：420 - 310 = 110杯。每家都送370，C店短缺50，B店多出60。星期二：360、380、350、390。极差是390 - 350 = 40杯，一份370更合适。

极差就是最大值减最小值。它只用两端 - 星期一中间的370和380根本没用上。加上24小时店E的4,200杯，极差跳到4,200 - 310 = 3,890；只看街边店仍是110。统一配送前先看极差，并说清楚算进了哪些店。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片5（极差）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is the range?

Four shops average 370 cups on both Monday and Tuesday (1,480 / 4). Same average does not mean the same delivery. Monday: 380, 310, 420, 370. Sort and take max minus min: 420 - 310 = 110 cups. Send everyone 370 and Shop C is 50 short while Shop B has 60 left over. Tuesday: 360, 380, 350, 390. Range is 390 - 350 = 40 cups, so one size of 370 fits better.

The range is maximum minus minimum. It uses only the two ends - Monday skips 370 and 380 in the middle. Add Shop E, a 24-hour site at 4,200, and the range jumps to 4,200 - 310 = 3,890. Street shops alone stay at 110. Check the range before one truck size, and say which shops are included.

videos.title: What Is Descriptive Statistics? (Voiceover: Mandarin · Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 01/15 课
下一课：https://youtu.be/Yb4eqJPlp5g
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是描述性统计？

一份周一咖啡文件落到桌上：A店卖出310杯，B店420杯，C店4,200杯。照搬最忙的一行，你会多订牛奶；照搬最闲的一行，忙店午饭前就会断货。原始行本身管不了连锁店。

本短片讲的工具包，就是把这份文件变成决策的描述性统计。动手汇总之前，先对同一份文件问四个刻度：

- 中心 - 典型门店落在哪里
- 离散 - 这条线有多宽
- 形态 - 哪一侧更长（这里高端拉得很远：4,200 - 310 = 3,890杯）
- 关联 - 两个量是否一起动（只有杯数不够；要把杯数和例如月租配成一对）

用周一的一行或一个数，回答不了四个刻度。信任任何摘要之前，先点名刻度、门店和单位。这些刻度压缩的是你手里的文件 - 它们本身不会定人手、库存或价格。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片1（导论）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is descriptive statistics?

A Monday coffee file lands with three shops: Shop A sold 310 cups, Shop B sold 420, and Shop C sold 4,200. Copy the busiest row and you over-order milk. Copy the quietest and the busy shop runs dry. Raw rows alone do not manage a chain.

This short names the toolkit that turns that file into a decision: descriptive statistics. Before any summary, ask four dials on the same file:

- Center - where a typical shop sits
- Spread - how wide the line runs
- Shape - which side is long (here the high end stretches far: 4,200 - 310 = 3,890 cups)
- Association - whether two measures move together (cups alone are not enough; pair cups with something like monthly rent)

One Monday row or one number is not four answers. Name the dial, the shops, and the unit before you trust a summary. These dials condense the file you have - they do not by themselves set staffing, inventory, or prices.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 1 (intro)

videos.title: What is an Average?
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 02/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/65c91WfJ9ao
下一课：https://youtu.be/CesCYtKMxTo
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是平均数？

总部要一个数代表四家咖啡店的星期一：A店卖出250杯，B店300杯，C店350杯，D店500杯。照抄最忙的店，计划变成2,000杯；照抄最清闲的店，又只有1,000杯。四家店加起来其实只卖了1,400杯。

平均数就是这个总数的平均份额：把每个杯数加起来，再除以有几家店。250 + 300 + 350 + 500 = 1,400，1,400 / 4 = 350杯。4乘350又回到总数。在一条线上，350也是平衡点：带符号的差距加起来等于零。

用350看整体——不是每家店各自的销量，也不能拿它给每家店都配货。250和500的中点是375，不是350。总部要的那一个数：350杯。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片2（平均数）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is the mean?

Head office wants one number for four coffee shops on Monday: Shop A sold 250 cups, Shop B 300, Shop C 350, and Shop D 500. Copy the busiest shop and the plan is 2,000 cups. Copy the quietest and it is 1,000. The four shops sold only 1,400 together.

The mean is the equal share of that total: add every cup count, then divide by how many shops. 250 + 300 + 350 + 500 = 1,400, and 1,400 / 4 = 350 cups. Four times 350 brings the total back. On a line, 350 is also the balance point: the signed gaps add to zero.

Use 350 for the group picture — not as each shop's own sales, and not as stock for every door. The midpoint of 250 and 500 is 375, not 350. Head office's one number: 350 cups.

videos.title: What Is the Median?
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 03/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/Yb4eqJPlp5g
下一课：https://youtu.be/_T9_d_F6120
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是中位数？

A店有五天杯数：80、100、120、140，以及一天高峰460。平均数是 900 / 5 = 180杯。把180当成典型日目标，四天普通日（80到140）全部达不到，只有高峰日过线。

中位数回答另一个问题：典型的一天卖多少？从小到大排好，读中间那个。五天时中间是第三位：120杯，落在安静的几天里。把高峰从460改成4,000，平均数会飙升，中位数仍是120 - 它看的是队列里的位置，不是高峰拉多远。

B店有四天：100、200、300、800。没有单独的正中间，就平分两个中间值：(200 + 300) / 2 = 250。奇数个：读一个中间；偶数个：把两个中间值平均。

中位数对高峰日稳健，也适用于只能排序的答案（差、一般、好、很好、优秀），那些词加不起来。它仍会藏起总数和高峰 - 备货时还要看着原始天数。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片3（中位数）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is the median?

Shop A has five Monday-to-Friday style days: 80, 100, 120, 140, and one rush at 460. The average is 900 / 5 = 180 cups. Set 180 as the typical-day target and four ordinary days (80 to 140) all miss it. Only the rush clears it.

The median answers a different question: what does a typical day sell? Sort low to high and read the middle. With five days the middle place is the third: 120 cups. That sits among the quiet days. Grow the rush from 460 to 4,000 and the average jumps, but the median stays 120 - it uses place in the queue, not how far the rush sticks out.

Shop B has four days: 100, 200, 300, 800. No single middle place, so share the two middles: (200 + 300) / 2 = 250. Odd count: read one middle. Even count: average the two middle values.

The median is robust to a rush day, and it works for ranked answers (poor, fair, good, very good, excellent) where you cannot add the words. It still hides the total and the rush - keep the raw days in view when planning stock.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 3 (median)

videos.title: What is the mode? (Voiceover: Mandarin · Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 04/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/CesCYtKMxTo
下一课：https://youtu.be/ScfJ73KDK7E
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是众数？

工厂要问：星期一前哪一种杯盖该开最大一批？你卖小杯、中杯、大杯。星期一订单：小杯40、中杯280、大杯100。这些是标签，加不起来 - 没有工厂能做的“平均杯盖”，也没有正中间的杯盖。

数每种规格出现几次。中杯柱最高，280，高于小杯40和大杯100。出现次数最多的值（或类别）就是众数。中杯开最大一批。小杯和大杯仍要备：两边合计还有140单，而且280本身不是完整的杯盖订单。

注意：另一个星期一若是小杯40、中杯150、大杯150，就是双峰 - 两个众数并列最高。各一单（1、1、1）则没有众数。若每天都不同 - 例如52、64、100、136、148 - 就分组：100以下两天，100到150三天。没有一天超过150，空的那一组不画在图上。众数组是100到150。

标签加不起来、又要最常见选择时，用众数。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片4（众数）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is the mode?

The factory asks which lid should get the largest run before Monday. You sell Small, Medium, and Large. Monday's orders: Small 40, Medium 280, Large 100. These are labels, not cups you can add - there is no average lid and no middle lid the plant can make.

Count how often each size appears. Medium's bar is tallest at 280, above Small at 40 and Large at 100. That most common value (or category) is the mode. Run Medium largest. Still stock Small and Large: together they still have 140 orders, and 280 is not a full lid order by itself.

Drawbacks: a second Monday with Small 40, Medium 150, Large 150 is bimodal - two modes share the top. Three orders of one each (1, 1, 1) means no mode. When every day differs - say 52, 64, 100, 136, 148 - group the days: Under 100 has two days, 100 to 150 has three. No day sold over 150, so that empty band stays off the chart. The modal class is 100 to 150.

Use the mode when labels cannot be added and you need the most common choice.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 4 (mode)

videos.title: What Are Percentiles? (Narration: Mandarin · Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 06/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/ScfJ73KDK7E
下一课：https://youtu.be/kjC15c1R1s8
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是百分位数？

总部想先拜访强店。D店卖了390杯。单看390说不出强不强。五家店星期一：360、420、280、390、310。平均数约352，D只高38。排序后D是第4/5名：4家在390及以下，4 / 5 = 80%。390是第80百分位数；D店的百分位秩是80%。

找第80：排序，0.80 x 5 = 4，读第4位=390。第50时，0.50 x 5 = 2.5向上取整到第3位。再加高于420的F店，4/6约67%。百分位数是队列位置，不是领先多少。要写明店铺组、时期和方法。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片6（百分位数）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is a percentile?

Head office wants strong shops to visit. Shop D sold 390 cups. Alone, 390 cannot say if that is strong. Five shops Monday: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. Average about 352 puts D only 38 above average. On the ordered line D is 4th of 5: 4 shops sit at or below 390, so 4 / 5 = 80%. 390 is the 80th percentile; Shop D's percentile rank is 80%.

To find the 80th: sort, 0.80 x 5 = 4, read place 4 = 390. For the 50th, 0.50 x 5 = 2.5 rounds up to place 3. Add Shop F above 420 and 4 of 6 at or below 390 is about 67%. A percentile is a place in line, not how far ahead. Report the group, period, and method.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 6 (percentile)

videos.title: What is Interquartile Range? (Voiceover: Mandarin · Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 07/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/DH54xluCX2Y
下一课：https://youtu.be/ArbB7t9K-r8
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是四分位距？

总部要给街边店定一个正常牛奶带宽，不要被最怪的一天带跑。五家店：360、420、280、390、310。两端差420 - 280 = 140杯。排序：280、310、360、390、420。Q1（第25）在0.25 x 5 = 1.25 -＞ 2，是310。Q3（第75）在0.75 x 5 = 3.75 -＞ 4，是390。IQR = 390 - 310 = 80杯，就是中间盒子的宽度。

加上F店4,200杯，两端拉到3,920，IQR大约只到110。IQR对远店稳健但不是免疫，也不能单独给远店做计划。要写明店铺组、时期和最近秩方法。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片7（四分位距）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is the interquartile range?

Head office wants a normal milk band for street shops, not a band set by the strangest day. Five shops: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. End to end is 420 - 280 = 140 cups. Sort: 280, 310, 360, 390, 420. Q1 (25th) at place 0.25 x 5 = 1.25 -＞ 2 is 310. Q3 (75th) at 0.75 x 5 = 3.75 -＞ 4 is 390. IQR = 390 - 310 = 80 cups - the width of the middle box.

Add Shop F at 4,200 and the ends stretch to 3,920, while the IQR only moves to about 110. The IQR is robust to a far shop but not immune, and it does not plan for the far day itself. Report group, period, and nearest-rank method.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 7 (IQR)

videos.title: What Are Variance and Standard Deviation? (Voiceover: Mandarin · Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 08/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/kjC15c1R1s8
下一课：https://youtu.be/xGvixiumd1s
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是方差和标准差？

两家店五天平均都是365杯（1,825 / 5）。A店：300、330、365、400、430 - 大约上下摆65。B店：350、360、365、370、380 - 留在15以内。平均数相同，人手计划不同。

相对365的带符号差距加总为零，所以要平方。A店平方和10,900；除以5：方差=2,180平方杯。标准差是开方，约47杯。B店：方差100，标准差=10。标准差用上每一天，单位是杯 - 它本身不是“多加47杯人手”的订单。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片8（方差与标准差）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What are variance and standard deviation?

Two shops both average 365 cups over five days (1,825 / 5). Shop A: 300, 330, 365, 400, 430 - swings about 65 either side. Shop B: 350, 360, 365, 370, 380 - stays within 15. Same average, different staffing plan.

Signed gaps from 365 cancel to zero, so we square them. For A the sum of squares is 10,900; share by 5: variance = 2,180 square cups. Standard deviation is the square root, about 47 cups. Shop B: variance 100, SD = 10. SD uses every day and speaks in cups - it is not an order to add 47 staff cups by itself.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 8 (variance and SD)

videos.title: What is the Coefficient of Variation?
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 09/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/ArbB7t9K-r8
下一课：https://youtu.be/Z9NGZIeHHMI
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是变异系数？

A店小：一天大约300杯，标准差30。B店大：大约3,000杯，标准差150。按杯数算，B的摆幅大5倍。相对各自日销量，A是30 / 300 = 10%，B是150 / 3,000 = 5%。按规模看，A更难计划。

CV =（标准差 / 平均数）x 100%，是无单位的百分比 - 杯会约掉。美元也可以得到同样的10%。平均极小时CV会爆。店铺规模不同、又要公平比较摆幅占比时，用CV。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片9（变异系数）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is the coefficient of variation?

Shop A is small: about 300 cups a day, SD 30. Shop B is big: about 3,000 cups, SD 150. In raw cups B swings five times more. Relative to its own day, A is 30 / 300 = 10%, and B is 150 / 3,000 = 5%. For its size, A is the harder shop to plan.

CV = (standard deviation / average) x 100%, a unit-free percent - cups cancel. The same 10% can appear for dollars too. Watch tiny averages: CV can blow up. Use CV when shops differ in size and you need a fair share-of-swing comparison.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 9 (CV)

videos.title: What are outliers? (VO: Mandarin · Visuals: English)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 10/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/xGvixiumd1s
下一课：https://youtu.be/IfZSkxjGnIo
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaAYOXslb5tY

什么是异常值？

五家街边店：360、420、280、390、310。加上F店4,200 - 是B店420的十倍。删掉真忙的店会备货不足；留下打字多一个0，平均数大约从352跳到993。

篱笆规则：五家的IQR是80。1.5 x 80 = 120。下篱笆310 - 120 = 190；上篱笆390 + 120 = 510。4,200高出上篱笆3,690，被标出。六家时篱笆会动，但4,200仍被标出。标出是请你查故事 - 打字错误、异常星期一、或另一类店 - 不是自动删除。

商务统计 - 模块1 - 短片10（异常值）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

What is an outlier?

Five street shops: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. Add Shop F at 4,200 - ten times Shop B's 420. Delete a real busy site and you understock; keep a typing slip and the average jumps from about 352 to about 993.

Fence rule: IQR of the five is 80. 1.5 x 80 = 120. Lower fence 310 - 120 = 190; upper 390 + 120 = 510. 4,200 sits 3,690 above the upper fence, so it is flagged. With six shops the fence moves but 4,200 is still flagged. A flag means check the story - typing slip, one-off Monday, or a different kind of shop - not automatic delete.

videos.title: 咩係協方差？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 13/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/HLjM8afzCfE
下一課：https://youtu.be/MEAbjgacOFo
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係協方差？

五間店：租金10,000、12,000、13,000、16,000、19,000（平均14,000），杯數300、330、360、400、460（平均370）。每間計（租金-14,000）x（杯數-370）。五個乘積都為正；合計880,000；除以5：協方差=176,000美元-杯。為正表示租金偏高時，杯數亦往往偏高。

改寫成美分，數字變成17,600,000 - 店冇變，單位變咗。將符號讀成線性同向/反向。唔好將絕對大小當成強度，亦唔好將協方差當成租金導致銷量嘅證明。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片13（協方差）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is covariance?

Five shops: rents 10,000, 12,000, 13,000, 16,000, 19,000 (average 14,000) and cups 300, 330, 360, 400, 460 (average 370). For each shop, (rent - 14,000) x (cups - 370). All five products are positive; sum 880,000; share by 5: covariance = 176,000 dollar-cups. Positive means when rent is above average, cups tend to be too.

Rewrite rent in cents and the number becomes 17,600,000 - same shops, different unit. Read the sign as direction of linear co-movement. Do not read raw size as strength, and do not treat covariance as proof that rent causes sales.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 13 (covariance)

videos.title: 咩係相關系數？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 14/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/t42YutwalcM
下一課：https://youtu.be/OByfqODVbgI
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係相關系數？

同協方差短片相同嘅五間店：租金1萬到1.9萬，杯數300到460。協方差係176,000美元-杯。除以（租金標準差 x 杯數標準差）：約3,162 x 55.9 ≈ 176,750。相關系數 r ≈ 176,000 / 176,750 ≈ +0.996，約+1.00。

r 喺無單位嘅 -1 到 +1 尺上面。靠近+1係強正線性形態；靠近-1則相反。租金改成美分，r仍然約+1.00。一齊郁得強，仍然唔係「提高租金就能提高銷量」嘅證明。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片14（相關系數）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is correlation?

Same five shops as the covariance short: rents 10k-19k and cups 300-460. Covariance is 176,000 dollar-cups. Divide by (rent SD x cups SD): about 3,162 x 55.9 ≈ 176,750. Correlation r ≈ 176,000 / 176,750 ≈ +0.996, about +1.00.

r sits on a unit-free scale from -1 to +1. Near +1 is a strong positive linear pattern; near -1 the opposite. Switch rent to cents and r stays about +1.00. Strong together-movement is still not proof that raising rent raises cups.

videos.title: 咩係偏度？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 11/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/wqzTS_DlK0g
下一課：https://youtu.be/HLjM8afzCfE
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係偏度？

兩間店五日合計都係500杯，平均100。A店：70、80、90、100、160 - 三日低過100，一日高峰160。B店係鏡像：40、100、110、120、130。按100備貨，A店三日浪費，B店三日短缺。相同平均、相同方差（1,000）分唔開佢哋。

偏度用三次方差距，符號留得住。A嘅立方和係+180,000；標準化偏度約+1.1（右偏 / 高端更長）。B約-1.1。佢指出邊一側更長 - 唔係更好/更差，亦唔能單獨決定備幾多杯。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片11（偏度）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is skewness?

Two shops both total 500 cups over five days, average 100. Shop A: 70, 80, 90, 100, 160 - three days below 100, one rush at 160. Shop B is the mirror: 40, 100, 110, 120, 130. Prep 100 at A wastes on three days; at B you run short on three. Same average and same variance (1,000) cannot tell them apart.

Skewness uses cubed gaps so the sign survives. A's sum of cubes is +180,000; standardized skewness about +1.1 (right / long high side). B is about -1.1. It names which side is long - not better/worse, and not how many cups to prep by itself.

videos.title: 咩係峰度？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 12/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/ktDsOsvrqgA
下一課：https://youtu.be/t42YutwalcM
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係峰度？

兩間店平均都係100，方差相同、偏度為零，但尾巴唔同。A店：52、64、100、136、148 - 四日偏差約36-48。B店：40、100、100、100、160 - 三日啱啱好，兩日各偏60。穩定緩衝更能覆蓋A；B會喺少見嘅遠日失手。

峰度睇差距嘅四次方 - 越高尾巴越重。A約1.3；B係2.5。誤區：尖峰 - 要讀尾巴，唔係中間有幾尖。正態基準係3；超額峰度=峰度-3。佢本身唔話你知備幾多杯。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片12（峰度）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is kurtosis?

Two shops average 100 with the same variance and zero skewness, but different tails. Shop A: 52, 64, 100, 136, 148 - moderate misses of 36-48 on four days. Shop B: 40, 100, 100, 100, 160 - spot on three days, then off by 60 twice. A steady buffer covers A more often; B fails on the rare far days.

Kurtosis weighs the fourth power of the gaps - higher means heavier tails. A is about 1.3; B is 2.5. Myth: peakedness - read tails, not how pointy the middle looks. A Normal benchmark is 3; excess kurtosis is kurtosis minus 3. It does not say how many reserve cups to hold by itself.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 12 (kurtosis)

videos.title: 咩係決策儀表板？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 15/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/MEAbjgacOFo
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係決策儀表板？

一份星期一檔案：A店310、B店420、C店4,200。平均數被C拉高；中間店係420；兩端差3,890杯。每個數答唔同問題。決策儀表板就係開篇四個刻度做成一塊板：中心、離散、形態、關聯。

決策問邊個刻度，就配相應度量（本模組方差/標準差除以n）。形態用偏度、峰度同異常籬笆做複查標記 - 唔係自動證明錄入錯誤。關聯需要第二欄（租金配杯數）：協方差176,000美元-杯、r約+1.00仍然唔能證明因果。行動前先點名刻度、店鋪、時期同單位，並寫上限度。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片15（回顧）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is a decision dashboard?

One Monday file: Shop A 310, Shop B 420, Shop C 4,200. The average is pulled by C; the middle shop is 420; end to end is 3,890 cups. Each answers a different question. A decision dashboard is the four dials from the opening short on one board: center, spread, shape, and association.

Pair the dial the decision asks with a matching measure (in this module variance/SD divide by n). Shape uses skewness, kurtosis, and outlier fences as review flags - not automatic proof of error. Association needs a second column (rent beside cups): covariance 176,000 dollar-cups and r about +1.00 still do not prove cause. Name the dial, the shops, period, and unit, then write the limitation before you act.

videos.title: 咩係平均數？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 02/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/ZOBr_EKolqY
下一課：https://youtu.be/4mEBrL097Lc
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係平均數？

總部要一個數代表四間咖啡店嘅星期一：A店賣出250杯，B店300杯，C店350杯，D店500杯。照抄最忙嗰間，計劃變成2,000杯；照抄最清閒嗰間，又得1,000杯。四間店加埋其實先賣咗1,400杯。

平均數就係呢個總數嘅平均份額：將每個杯數加埋，再除以有幾多間店。250 + 300 + 350 + 500 = 1,400，1,400 / 4 = 350杯。4乘350又返到總數。喺一條線上面，350亦係平衡點：帶符號嘅差距加埋等於零。

用350睇整體——唔係每間店各自嘅銷量，亦唔可以攞佢畀每間店都配貨。250同500嘅中點係375，唔係350。總部要嗰一個數：350杯。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片2（平均數）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is the mean?

Head office wants one number for four coffee shops on Monday: Shop A sold 250 cups, Shop B 300, Shop C 350, and Shop D 500. Copy the busiest shop and the plan is 2,000 cups. Copy the quietest and it is 1,000. The four shops sold only 1,400 together.

The mean is the equal share of that total: add every cup count, then divide by how many shops. 250 + 300 + 350 + 500 = 1,400, and 1,400 / 4 = 350 cups. Four times 350 brings the total back. On a line, 350 is also the balance point: the signed gaps add to zero.

Use 350 for the group picture — not as each shop's own sales, and not as stock for every door. The midpoint of 250 and 500 is 375, not 350. Head office's one number: 350 cups.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 2 (mean)

videos.title: 咩係百分位數？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 06/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/3vf6_kEQa-w
下一課：https://youtu.be/On8TxZxhu1s
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係百分位數？

總部想先拜訪強店。D店賣咗390杯。單睇390講唔出強唔強。五間店星期一：360、420、280、390、310。平均數約352，D只高38。排好之後D係第4/5名：4間喺390及以下，4 / 5 = 80%。390係第80百分位數；D店嘅百分位秩係80%。

搵第80：排序，0.80 x 5 = 4，讀第4位=390。第50時，0.50 x 5 = 2.5向上取整到第3位。再加高過420嘅F店，4/6約67%。百分位數係隊列位置，唔係領先幾多。要寫明店鋪組、時期同方法。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片6（百分位數）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is a percentile?

Head office wants strong shops to visit. Shop D sold 390 cups. Alone, 390 cannot say if that is strong. Five shops Monday: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. Average about 352 puts D only 38 above average. On the ordered line D is 4th of 5: 4 shops sit at or below 390, so 4 / 5 = 80%. 390 is the 80th percentile; Shop D's percentile rank is 80%.

To find the 80th: sort, 0.80 x 5 = 4, read place 4 = 390. For the 50th, 0.50 x 5 = 2.5 rounds up to place 3. Add Shop F above 420 and 4 of 6 at or below 390 is about 67%. A percentile is a place in line, not how far ahead. Report the group, period, and method.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 6 (percentile)

videos.title: 咩係方差同標準差？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 08/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/On8TxZxhu1s
下一課：https://youtu.be/uRJdO2xTfsA
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係方差同標準差？

兩間店五日平均都係365杯（1,825 / 5）。A店：300、330、365、400、430 - 大約上下擺65。B店：350、360、365、370、380 - 留喺15以內。平均數相同，人手計劃唔同。

相對365嘅帶符號差距加總為零，所以要平方。A店平方和10,900；除以5：方差=2,180平方杯。標準差係開方，約47杯。B店：方差100，標準差=10。標準差用晒每日，單位係杯 - 佢本身唔係「多加47杯人手」嘅訂單。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片8（方差同標準差）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What are variance and standard deviation?

Two shops both average 365 cups over five days (1,825 / 5). Shop A: 300, 330, 365, 400, 430 - swings about 65 either side. Shop B: 350, 360, 365, 370, 380 - stays within 15. Same average, different staffing plan.

Signed gaps from 365 cancel to zero, so we square them. For A the sum of squares is 10,900; share by 5: variance = 2,180 square cups. Standard deviation is the square root, about 47 cups. Shop B: variance 100, SD = 10. SD uses every day and speaks in cups - it is not an order to add 47 staff cups by itself.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 8 (variance and SD)

videos.title: 咩係變異系數？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 09/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/uqPWBIGSl_s
下一課：https://youtu.be/wqzTS_DlK0g
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係變異系數？

A店細：一日大約300杯，標準差30。B店大：大約3,000杯，標準差150。按杯數計，B嘅擺幅大5倍。相對各自日銷量，A係30 / 300 = 10%，B係150 / 3,000 = 5%。按規模睇，A更難計劃。

CV =（標準差 / 平均數）x 100%，係無單位嘅百分比 - 杯會約走。美元都可以得到同樣嘅10%。平均極細時CV會爆。店鋪規模唔同、又要公平比較擺幅佔比時，用CV。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片9（變異系數）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is the coefficient of variation?

Shop A is small: about 300 cups a day, SD 30. Shop B is big: about 3,000 cups, SD 150. In raw cups B swings five times more. Relative to its own day, A is 30 / 300 = 10%, and B is 150 / 3,000 = 5%. For its size, A is the harder shop to plan.

CV = (standard deviation / average) x 100%, a unit-free percent - cups cancel. The same 10% can appear for dollars too. Watch tiny averages: CV can blow up. Use CV when shops differ in size and you need a fair share-of-swing comparison.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 9 (CV)

videos.title: 咩係描述性統計？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 01/15 課
下一課：https://youtu.be/Zq6YdxxpIjg
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係描述性統計？

一份星期一咖啡檔案落到檯面：A店賣出310杯，B店420杯，C店4,200杯。照搬最忙嗰一行，你會多訂牛奶；照搬最閒嗰一行，忙店午飯前就會斷貨。原始行本身管唔到連鎖店。

呢條短片講嘅工具包，就係把呢份檔案變成決策嘅描述性統計。動手匯總之前，先對同一份檔案問四個刻度：

- 中心 - 典型門店落喺邊度
- 離散 - 呢條線有幾闊
- 形態 - 邊一側更長（呢度高端拉得好遠：4,200 - 310 = 3,890杯）
- 關聯 - 兩個量係咪一齊郁（淨係杯數唔夠；要把杯數同例如月租配成一對）

用星期一嘅一行或者一個數，答唔到四個刻度。信任任何摘要之前，先點名刻度、門店同單位。呢啲刻度壓縮嘅係你手上嘅檔案 - 佢哋本身唔會定人手、庫存或者價格。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片1（導論）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is descriptive statistics?

A Monday coffee file lands with three shops: Shop A sold 310 cups, Shop B sold 420, and Shop C sold 4,200. Copy the busiest row and you over-order milk. Copy the quietest and the busy shop runs dry. Raw rows alone do not manage a chain.

This short names the toolkit that turns that file into a decision: descriptive statistics. Before any summary, ask four dials on the same file:

- Center - where a typical shop sits
- Spread - how wide the line runs
- Shape - which side is long (here the high end stretches far: 4,200 - 310 = 3,890 cups)
- Association - whether two measures move together (cups alone are not enough; pair cups with something like monthly rent)

One Monday row or one number is not four answers. Name the dial, the shops, and the unit before you trust a summary. These dials condense the file you have - they do not by themselves set staffing, inventory, or prices.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 1 (intro)

videos.title: 咩係中位數？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 03/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/Zq6YdxxpIjg
下一課：https://youtu.be/thWG6eyLqIs
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係中位數？

A店有五日杯數：80、100、120、140，同一日高峰460。平均數係 900 / 5 = 180杯。將180當成典型日目標，四日普通日（80到140）全部唔達標，得高峰日過線。

中位數答另一條問題：典型嘅一日賣幾多？由細到大排好，讀中間嗰個。五日時中間係第三位：120杯，落喺安靜嗰幾日入面。將高峰由460改成4,000，平均數會飆升，中位數仍然係120 - 佢睇嘅係隊列入面嘅位置，唔係高峰拉幾遠。

B店有四日：100、200、300、800。冇單獨正中間，就平分兩個中間值：(200 + 300) / 2 = 250。奇數個：讀一個中間；偶數個：將兩個中間值平均。

中位數對高峰日穩健，亦適用於淨係可以排序嘅答案（差、一般、好、很好、優秀），嗰啲詞加唔起嚟。佢仍然會藏起總數同高峰 - 備貨時仲要睇住原始日數。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片3（中位數）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is the median?

Shop A has five Monday-to-Friday style days: 80, 100, 120, 140, and one rush at 460. The average is 900 / 5 = 180 cups. Set 180 as the typical-day target and four ordinary days (80 to 140) all miss it. Only the rush clears it.

The median answers a different question: what does a typical day sell? Sort low to high and read the middle. With five days the middle place is the third: 120 cups. That sits among the quiet days. Grow the rush from 460 to 4,000 and the average jumps, but the median stays 120 - it uses place in the queue, not how far the rush sticks out.

Shop B has four days: 100, 200, 300, 800. No single middle place, so share the two middles: (200 + 300) / 2 = 250. Odd count: read one middle. Even count: average the two middle values.

The median is robust to a rush day, and it works for ranked answers (poor, fair, good, very good, excellent) where you cannot add the words. It still hides the total and the rush - keep the raw days in view when planning stock.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 3 (median)

videos.title: 咩係眾數？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 04/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/4mEBrL097Lc
下一課：https://youtu.be/3vf6_kEQa-w
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係眾數？

工廠要問：星期一前邊一種杯蓋應該開最大一批？你賣細杯、中杯、大杯。星期一訂單：細杯40、中杯280、大杯100。呢啲係標籤，加唔起嚟 - 冇工廠可以整嘅「平均杯蓋」，亦冇正中間嘅杯蓋。

數每種規格出現幾次。中杯柱最高，280，高過細杯40同大杯100。出現次數最多嘅值（或者類別）就係眾數。中杯開最大一批。細杯同大杯都要備：兩邊合計仲有140單，而且280本身唔係完整嘅杯蓋訂單。

注意：另一個星期一如果係細杯40、中杯150、大杯150，就係雙峰 - 兩個眾數並列最高。各一單（1、1、1）就冇眾數。如果每日都唔同 - 例如52、64、100、136、148 - 就分組：100以下兩日，100到150三日。冇一日超過150，空嗰一組唔畫喺圖上。眾數組係100到150。

標籤加唔起嚟、又要最常見選擇時，用眾數。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片4（眾數）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is the mode?

The factory asks which lid should get the largest run before Monday. You sell Small, Medium, and Large. Monday's orders: Small 40, Medium 280, Large 100. These are labels, not cups you can add - there is no average lid and no middle lid the plant can make.

Count how often each size appears. Medium's bar is tallest at 280, above Small at 40 and Large at 100. That most common value (or category) is the mode. Run Medium largest. Still stock Small and Large: together they still have 140 orders, and 280 is not a full lid order by itself.

Drawbacks: a second Monday with Small 40, Medium 150, Large 150 is bimodal - two modes share the top. Three orders of one each (1, 1, 1) means no mode. When every day differs - say 52, 64, 100, 136, 148 - group the days: Under 100 has two days, 100 to 150 has three. No day sold over 150, so that empty band stays off the chart. The modal class is 100 to 150.

Use the mode when labels cannot be added and you need the most common choice.

Business Statistics - Module 1 - Short 4 (mode)

videos.title: 咩係全距？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 05/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/thWG6eyLqIs
下一課：https://youtu.be/5zBS6WEOSQw
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係全距？

四間店星期一同星期二嘅平均數都係370杯（1,480 / 4）。平均數相同，送貨計劃未必相同。星期一：380、310、420、370。排好之後最大減最小：420 - 310 = 110杯。每間都送370，C店短缺50，B店多出60。星期二：360、380、350、390。全距係390 - 350 = 40杯，一份370更合適。

全距就係最大值減最小值。佢淨係用兩端 - 星期一中間嘅370同380根本無用到。加上24小時店E嘅4,200杯，全距跳到4,200 - 310 = 3,890；淨睇街邊店仍然係110。統一配送前先睇全距，並講清楚計入咗邊啲店。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片5（全距）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is the range?

Four shops average 370 cups on both Monday and Tuesday (1,480 / 4). Same average does not mean the same delivery. Monday: 380, 310, 420, 370. Sort and take max minus min: 420 - 310 = 110 cups. Send everyone 370 and Shop C is 50 short while Shop B has 60 left over. Tuesday: 360, 380, 350, 390. Range is 390 - 350 = 40 cups, so one size of 370 fits better.

The range is maximum minus minimum. It uses only the two ends - Monday skips 370 and 380 in the middle. Add Shop E, a 24-hour site at 4,200, and the range jumps to 4,200 - 310 = 3,890. Street shops alone stay at 110. Check the range before one truck size, and say which shops are included.

videos.title: 咩係四分位距？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 07/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/5zBS6WEOSQw
下一課：https://youtu.be/uqPWBIGSl_s
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係四分位距？

總部要畀街邊店定一個正常牛奶帶寬，唔好畀最怪嗰一日帶跑。五間店：360、420、280、390、310。兩端差420 - 280 = 140杯。排序：280、310、360、390、420。Q1（第25）喺0.25 x 5 = 1.25 -＞ 2，係310。Q3（第75）喺0.75 x 5 = 3.75 -＞ 4，係390。IQR = 390 - 310 = 80杯，就係中間盒子嘅闊度。

加上F店4,200杯，兩端拉到3,920，IQR大約只到110。IQR對遠店穩健但唔係免疫，亦唔能單獨畀遠店做計劃。要寫明店鋪組、時期同最近秩方法。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片7（四分位距）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is the interquartile range?

Head office wants a normal milk band for street shops, not a band set by the strangest day. Five shops: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. End to end is 420 - 280 = 140 cups. Sort: 280, 310, 360, 390, 420. Q1 (25th) at place 0.25 x 5 = 1.25 -＞ 2 is 310. Q3 (75th) at 0.75 x 5 = 3.75 -＞ 4 is 390. IQR = 390 - 310 = 80 cups - the width of the middle box.

Add Shop F at 4,200 and the ends stretch to 3,920, while the IQR only moves to about 110. The IQR is robust to a far shop but not immune, and it does not plan for the far day itself. Report group, period, and nearest-rank method.

videos.title: 咩係異常值？（旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡連鎖嘅描述性指標 · 旁白：粵語 · 畫面：English · 第 10/15 課
上一課：https://youtu.be/uRJdO2xTfsA
下一課：https://youtu.be/ktDsOsvrqgA
播放清單：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVkf6VUEhnuM

咩係異常值？

五間街邊店：360、420、280、390、310。加上F店4,200 - 係B店420嘅十倍。刪走真忙嘅店會備貨不足；留低打字多一個0，平均數大約由352跳到993。

籬笆規則：五間嘅IQR係80。1.5 x 80 = 120。下籬笆310 - 120 = 190；上籬笆390 + 120 = 510。4,200高過上籬笆3,690，被標出。六間時籬笆會郁，但4,200仍然被標出。標出係請你查故事 - 打字錯誤、異常星期一、或者另一類店 - 唔係自動刪除。

商務統計 - 模組1 - 短片10（異常值）
覺得有用嘅話，訂閱下一集。

—— English ——

What is an outlier?

Five street shops: 360, 420, 280, 390, 310. Add Shop F at 4,200 - ten times Shop B's 420. Delete a real busy site and you understock; keep a typing slip and the average jumps from about 352 to about 993.

Fence rule: IQR of the five is 80. 1.5 x 80 = 120. Lower fence 310 - 120 = 190; upper 390 + 120 = 510. 4,200 sits 3,690 above the upper fence, so it is flagged. With six shops the fence moves but 4,200 is still flagged. A flag means check the story - typing slip, one-off Monday, or a different kind of shop - not automatic delete.

videos.title: 什么是描述性统计？ (普通话)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 01/15 课
下一课：https://youtu.be/m3grqaFvtGI
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdpUsWgRbvaE

什么是描述性统计？

一份周一咖啡文件落到桌上：A店卖出310杯，B店420杯，C店4,200杯。照搬最忙的一行，你会多订牛奶；照搬最闲的一行，忙店午饭前就会断货。原始行本身管不了连锁店。

本短片讲的工具包，就是把这份文件变成决策的描述性统计。动手汇总之前，先对同一份文件问四个刻度：

- 中心 - 典型门店落在哪里
- 离散 - 这条线有多宽
- 形态 - 哪一侧更长（这里高端拉得很远：4,200 - 310 = 3,890杯）
- 关联 - 两个量是否一起动（只有杯数不够；要把杯数和例如月租配成一对）

用周一的一行或一个数，回答不了四个刻度。信任任何摘要之前，先点名刻度、门店和单位。这些刻度压缩的是你手里的文件 - 它们本身不会定人手、库存或价格。

videos.title: 什么是平均数？ (普通话)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 02/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/f8_qd5CERLA
下一课：https://youtu.be/Rt-Y9NbuLF4
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdpUsWgRbvaE

什么是平均数？

总部要一个数代表四家咖啡店的星期一：A店卖出250杯，B店300杯，C店350杯，D店500杯。照抄最忙的店，计划变成2,000杯；照抄最清闲的店，又只有1,000杯。四家店加起来其实只卖了1,400杯。

平均数就是这个总数的平均份额：把每个杯数加起来，再除以有几家店。250 + 300 + 350 + 500 = 1,400，1,400 / 4 = 350杯。4乘350又回到总数。在一条线上，350也是平衡点：带符号的差距加起来等于零。

用350看整体——不是每家店各自的销量，也不能拿它给每家店都配货。250和500的中点是375，不是350。总部要的那一个数：350杯。

videos.title: 什么是中位数？ (普通话)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 03/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/m3grqaFvtGI
下一课：https://youtu.be/ZCdD1rk3yU0
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdpUsWgRbvaE

什么是中位数？

A店有五天杯数：80、100、120、140，以及一天高峰460。平均数是 900 / 5 = 180杯。把180当成典型日目标，四天普通日（80到140）全部达不到，只有高峰日过线。

中位数回答另一个问题：典型的一天卖多少？从小到大排好，读中间那个。五天时中间是第三位：120杯，落在安静的几天里。把高峰从460改成4,000，平均数会飙升，中位数仍是120 - 它看的是队列里的位置，不是高峰拉多远。

B店有四天：100、200、300、800。没有单独的正中间，就平分两个中间值：(200 + 300) / 2 = 250。奇数个：读一个中间；偶数个：把两个中间值平均。

中位数对高峰日稳健，也适用于只能排序的答案（差、一般、好、很好、优秀），那些词加不起来。它仍会藏起总数和高峰 - 备货时还要看着原始天数。

videos.title: 什么是众数？ (普通话)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 04/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/Rt-Y9NbuLF4
下一课：https://youtu.be/6Fi60ncHtTM
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdpUsWgRbvaE

什么是众数？

工厂要问：星期一前哪一种杯盖该开最大一批？你卖小杯、中杯、大杯。星期一订单：小杯40、中杯280、大杯100。这些是标签，加不起来 - 没有工厂能做的“平均杯盖”，也没有正中间的杯盖。

数每种规格出现几次。中杯柱最高，280，高于小杯40和大杯100。出现次数最多的值（或类别）就是众数。中杯开最大一批。小杯和大杯仍要备：两边合计还有140单，而且280本身不是完整的杯盖订单。

注意：另一个星期一若是小杯40、中杯150、大杯150，就是双峰 - 两个众数并列最高。各一单（1、1、1）则没有众数。若每天都不同 - 例如52、64、100、136、148 - 就分组：100以下两天，100到150三天。没有一天超过150，空的那一组不画在图上。众数组是100到150。

标签加不起来、又要最常见选择时，用众数。

videos.title: 什么是极差？ (普通话)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 05/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/ZCdD1rk3yU0
下一课：https://youtu.be/tY3jYdQR538
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdpUsWgRbvaE

什么是极差？

四家店星期一和星期二的平均数都是370杯（1,480 / 4）。平均数相同，送货计划未必相同。星期一：380、310、420、370。排序后最大减最小：420 - 310 = 110杯。每家都送370，C店短缺50，B店多出60。星期二：360、380、350、390。极差是390 - 350 = 40杯，一份370更合适。

极差就是最大值减最小值。它只用两端 - 星期一中间的370和380根本没用上。加上24小时店E的4,200杯，极差跳到4,200 - 310 = 3,890；只看街边店仍是110。统一配送前先看极差，并说清楚算进了哪些店。

videos.title: 什么是百分位数？ (普通话)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 06/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/6Fi60ncHtTM
下一课：https://youtu.be/7o5Sl9cVGq0
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdpUsWgRbvaE

什么是百分位数？

总部想先拜访强店。D店卖了390杯。单看390说不出强不强。五家店星期一：360、420、280、390、310。平均数约352，D只高38。排序后D是第4/5名：4家在390及以下，4 / 5 = 80%。390是第80百分位数；D店的百分位秩是80%。

找第80：排序，0.80 x 5 = 4，读第4位=390。第50时，0.50 x 5 = 2.5向上取整到第3位。再加高于420的F店，4/6约67%。百分位数是队列位置，不是领先多少。要写明店铺组、时期和方法。

videos.title: 什么是方差和标准差？ (普通话)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 08/15 课

播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdpUsWgRbvaE

什么是方差和标准差？

两家店五天平均都是365杯（1,825 / 5）。A店：300、330、365、400、430 - 大约上下摆65。B店：350、360、365、370、380 - 留在15以内。平均数相同，人手计划不同。

相对365的带符号差距加总为零，所以要平方。A店平方和10,900；除以5：方差=2,180平方杯。标准差是开方，约47杯。B店：方差100，标准差=10。标准差用上每一天，单位是杯 - 它本身不是“多加47杯人手”的订单。

videos.title: 什么是变异系数？ (普通话)
videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 09/15 课

播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdpUsWgRbvaE

什么是变异系数？

A店小：一天大约300杯，标准差30。B店大：大约3,000杯，标准差150。按杯数算，B的摆幅大5倍。相对各自日销量，A是30 / 300 = 10%，B是150 / 3,000 = 5%。按规模看，A更难计划。

CV =（标准差 / 平均数）x 100%，是无单位的百分比 - 杯会约掉。美元也可以得到同样的10%。平均极小时CV会爆。店铺规模不同、又要公平比较摆幅占比时，用CV。

什么是偏度？

两家店五天合计都是500杯，平均100。A店：70、80、90、100、160 - 三天低于100，一天高峰160。B店是镜像：40、100、110、120、130。按100备货，A店三天浪费，B店三天短缺。相同平均、相同方差（1,000）分不开它们。

偏度用三次方差距，符号能留下来。A的立方和是+180,000；标准化偏度约+1.1（右偏 / 高端更长）。B约-1.1。它指出哪一侧更长 - 不是更好/更差，也不能单独决定备多少杯。

什么是峰度？

两家店平均都是100，方差相同、偏度为零，但尾巴不同。A店：52、64、100、136、148 - 四天偏差约36-48。B店：40、100、100、100、160 - 三天正好，两天各偏60。稳定缓冲更能覆盖A；B会在少见的远天上失手。

峰度看差距的四次方 - 越高尾巴越重。A约1.3；B是2.5。误区：尖峰 - 要读尾巴，不是中间有多尖。正态基准是3；超额峰度=峰度-3。它本身不告诉你备多少杯。

videos.description:
系列：STAT M01 · 咖啡连锁的描述性指标 · 普通话 · 第 13/15 课
上一课：https://youtu.be/bB_gCeh0WH8

什么是协方差？

五家店：租金10,000、12,000、13,000、16,000、19,000（平均14,000），杯数300、330、360、400、460（平均370）。每家算（租金-14,000）x（杯数-370）。五个乘积都为正；合计880,000；除以5：协方差=176,000美元-杯。为正表示租金偏高时，杯数也往往偏高。

改写成美分，数字变成17,600,000 - 店没变，单位变了。把符号读成线性同向/反向。不要把绝对大小当成强度，也不要把协方差当成租金导致销量的证明。

videos.title: Inverting the diagnostic evidence (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 11/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/aej-TiDk2Vw
Next: https://youtu.be/6bFNgCBpfUU
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQvvdqc_XMA

Inverting the diagnostic evidence

Bayes' rule flips evidence into belief: blend the prior base rate with how the alert behaves when the machine is broken versus healthy.

On 1,000 Shop E hours, 40 are true failures (prior 4%). At 90 percent sensitivity the sensor fires 36 true alerts; false alerts swell the total to 84. Posterior P(Broken | Alert) = 36/84 ≈ 42.9 percent — not 90 percent. Act with the posterior plus cost and safety procedures.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 11 (Bayes)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

把诊断证据倒过来读

贝叶斯法则把证据翻成信念：把先验基础率，与机器故障/正常时警报如何表现结合起来。

E店 1,000 工时里有 40 次真故障（先验 4%）。90% 灵敏度下有 36 次真报警；误报把警报总数抬到 84。后验 P(故障|警报) = 36/84 ≈ 42.9%——不是 90%。行动要看后验，再加成本与安全流程。

videos.title: The rare disaster trap (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 12/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/bNfB9M-cwGg
Next: https://youtu.be/2al_5do-sII
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQvvdqc_XMA

The rare disaster trap

The base-rate fallacy hits when the event is rare. Even a decent screen can flood you with false flags that outnumber true ones.

If 10 of 110 flags are genuine fraud, the posterior fraud probability is about 9.1 percent; the other 100 flags are false positives. Treat a flag as evidence, not proof — design the response with verified risk, customer impact, and approved controls.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 12 (base rate)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

低频灾难陷阱

事件很罕见时，基础率谬误最伤人。即便筛查还不错，误报也可能远多于真报。

若 110 次标记里只有 10 次是真实欺诈，后验欺诈概率约 9.1%；其余 100 次是误报。把标记当证据而非铁证——响应要结合核实风险、顾客影响与批准的管控。

Pricing the gamble

Expected monetary value (EMV) weights each payoff by its probability and sums. Use it to compare average financial outcomes — then check whether cash can absorb the bad path.

In a simplified machine ledger, self-insuring costs an expected 500 dollars versus a certain 600-dollar warranty. The 100-dollar EMV edge must still clear cash-flow risk and what the contract actually covers.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 13 (EMV)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

给这场赌注定价

预期货币价值（EMV）用概率给每个损益加权再求和。用它比较平均财务结果——然后检查现金能否扛住坏路径。

简化机台账本里，自担的期望成本是 500 美元，保修费是确定的 600 美元。100 美元的 EMV 优势，仍要过现金流风险与合同真实覆盖这一关。

Pricing the volatility

Expected value prices the center. Variance and standard deviation price the spread. Small firms can die on a bad draw even when the average looks fine.

For one machine, self-insurance expects 500 dollars with a standard deviation near 2,179 dollars. Compare both figures with the certain 600-dollar premium and what the warranty actually covers before you choose.

给波动定价

期望值给中心定价；方差与标准差给离散定价。小微企业即使平均看起来不错，一次坏结果也可能致命。

单台机器自担期望 500 美元，标准差约 2,179 美元。决策前，把这两个数与确定的 600 美元保费、以及保修真实覆盖对照。

videos.title: Are they really unrelated? (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 08/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/YSJMxdKcwvk
Next: https://youtu.be/PIqlS2G_hL0
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQvvdqc_XMA

Are they really unrelated?

Independence means P(A|B) = P(A), or equivalently P(A and B) = P(A)×P(B). Different shelves do not prove independent choices.

If the independence forecast says three percent joint demand, but the ledger shows 60 of 1,000 tickets take both decaf and oat milk (six percent), the conditional test failed. Plan inventory on the observed joint — not the independence shortcut.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 8 (independence)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

它们真的互不相关吗？

独立意味着 P(A|B) = P(A)，或等价地 P(A 且 B) = P(A)×P(B)。货架不同，并不证明选择独立。

若独立假设给出 3% 的联合需求，但台账显示 1,000 笔里有 60 笔同时要低因与燕麦奶（6%），条件检验就失败了。备货按观测到的联合需求，而不是独立捷径。

videos.title: Seeing tomorrow through probability (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 01/15
Next: https://youtu.be/Gwfkn0Ry1nc
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQvvdqc_XMA

Seeing tomorrow through probability

Descriptive dials can say Shop A averaged 420 cups, with a network standard deviation of 78. Those numbers summarize what already sold. They cannot change tomorrow. When a storm, a supply halt, or a viral crowd hits, how do you price that risk before it arrives?

Business probability answers with four pillars: define the universe of possible outcomes, update odds when context changes (conditioning), diagnose true faults behind alerts (inversion), and price bets with expected monetary value.

Descriptive statistics looks in the rearview mirror. Probability looks through the windshield: it maps uncertainty onto a zero-to-one scale so managers can commit resources before the future unfolds. A bad outcome does not prove a bad decision — judge the odds you chose, not one roll alone.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 1 (intro)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

用概率透视明天的商业不确定性

描述性指标可以说：A店平均卖出420杯，全网标准差是78杯。这些数字总结的是已经卖掉的杯子。它们改变不了明天。暴雨、断货或突然爆客来袭时，你怎么在危机到来前给风险定价？

商务概率用四大支柱作答：界定所有可能结果的全集、场景一变就更新胜率（条件）、从警报倒推真实故障（逆转）、用期望货币价值给赌注定价。

描述统计看后视镜。概率望向前挡风玻璃：把不确定性标在零到一的尺上，让管理者在未来展开前就能调配资源。一次不利结果不等于决策错了——评判你选的胜率，不要只看这一次掷骰。

商务概率基础 - 模块2 - 短片1（导论）

videos.title: Defining the universe of outcomes (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 02/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/iFxLhMzkpko
Next: https://youtu.be/EMS15zp53qw
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQvvdqc_XMA

Defining the universe of outcomes

Before you can price any business risk, you must answer a deceptively simple question: what are all the things that could possibly occur? Leave out even one transaction type and the model collapses on bad math.

The sample space S is the complete universe of distinct atomic outcomes; its total probability is 1.0. An event is any subset management cares about. Build S under the MECE rule: mutually exclusive (no overlap) and collectively exhaustive (no gaps).

Suppose a Monday register shows 1,000 orders: Beverage Only 600 (0.60), Food Only 100 (0.10), Bundle 300 (0.30). Those three add to 1.00. The food-purchase event is Food Only plus Bundle: 0.10 + 0.30 = 0.40.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 2 (sample space)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

穷尽界定业务结果的全集

在给任何商业风险定价之前，你必须先回答一个看似简单的问题：现场到底可能发生哪些情况？哪怕漏掉一种交易形态，模型也会因底层漏洞崩塌。

样本空间 S 是所有互不相同的基本结果的完整全集，总概率恒等于 1.0。事件是管理层关心的任一子集。搭建 S 要守 MECE：互斥（不重叠）且完全穷尽（无遗漏）。

假设周一收银有 1,000 笔订单：纯饮品 600（0.60）、纯餐点 100（0.10）、组合套餐 300（0.30）。三者之和为 1.00。购买食物事件 = 纯餐点 + 组合：0.10 + 0.30 = 0.40。

videos.title: The easy way to find failure (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 03/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/Gwfkn0Ry1nc
Next: https://youtu.be/2VattrauTno
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQvvdqc_XMA

The easy way to find failure

When a manager asks for the chance of at least one defect, do not list every failure path. The complement rule flips the question: find the probability of a flawless run, then subtract it from 1.0.

Suppose 940 of 1,000 espresso shots meet every standard. The clean-run probability is 0.94. VIP defect risk is 1.0 minus 0.94 — exactly 0.06. No need to tally bitter pulls, cold groupheads, and channeling one by one.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 3 (complement)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

找失败概率的捷径

当管理者问“至少一次瑕疵”的概率时，不要逐一枚举失败路径。对立事件法则把问题翻转：先算完美出品的概率，再用 1.0 减去它。

假设 1,000 杯浓缩里有 940 杯全部达标，完美概率是 0.94。贵宾遇到瑕疵的风险就是 1.0 减 0.94，精确等于 0.06。不必再把过萃、水温过低和通道效应分开加总。

videos.title: Reading the 2x2 retail matrix (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 04/15

Next: https://youtu.be/fh2KXpGIkY0

Reading the 2x2 retail matrix

A 2x2 ticket table separates two layers. Interior cells hold joint probabilities — both conditions at once. Outer margins hold marginal totals — one factor alone. The bottom-right corner always anchors at 1.0.

In a 1,000-order ledger: 120 tickets buy iced coffee and a pastry (joint 0.12). The iced row sums to 400 (marginal 0.40). The pastry column sums to 300 (marginal 0.30). Bundle decisions read the interior cell; margins only set category scale.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 4 (contingency table)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

读懂零售 2x2 列联表

2x2 客单表分两层。内部单元格是联合概率——两种条件同时成立；外侧边缘是边缘合计——只看单一因素。右下角总锚点恒为 1.0。

在 1,000 笔订单里：120 笔同时买冰咖啡与甜点（联合 0.12）；冷饮行合计 400（边缘 0.40）；甜点列合计 300（边缘 0.30）。套餐决策读内部单元格；边缘只用来判断品类规模。

videos.title: Don't count the pastry twice (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 05/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/2VattrauTno
Next: https://youtu.be/M_b0YOI78EY
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQvvdqc_XMA

Don't count the pastry twice

The general addition rule prices OR events: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A and B). When categories overlap, adding margins alone double-counts the bridge.

If iced coffee is 0.40, pastry is 0.30, and both together are 0.12, then either item appears on 0.40 + 0.30 − 0.12 = 0.58 of tickets. Budget the promotion for 58 percent — not 70 percent.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 5 (addition rule)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

别把甜点算两次

一般加法法则给“或”事件定价：P(A 或 B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A 且 B)。品类有重叠时，只加边缘会把交集算两遍。

若冷饮 0.40、甜点 0.30、两者兼有 0.12，则至少买其一的比例是 0.40 + 0.30 − 0.12 = 0.58。促销预算按 58% 计，而不是 70%。

商务概率基础 - 模块2 - 短片5（加法法则）

videos.title: Restricting the operational universe (Speech: English · Slides: 简体)
videos.description:
Series: STAT M02 · Probability for a coffee chain · Speech: English · Slides: 简体 · Lesson 06/15
Previous: https://youtu.be/fh2KXpGIkY0
Next: https://youtu.be/YSJMxdKcwvk
Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQvvdqc_XMA

Restricting the operational universe

Conditional probability P(A|B) asks: given we already sit inside B, what is the chance of A? Shrink the denominator to condition B before you quote a rate.

Among 1,000 tickets, 400 are iced. Of those, 120 also take a pastry. So P(pastry | iced) = 120 / 400 = 0.30 — not the unconditional pastry margin of 0.30 on the whole store, read inside the iced segment.

Business Probability Foundations - Module 2 - Short 6 (conditional probability)
If this helped, subscribe for the next short.

—— 普通话 ——

缩小运营世界再算概率

条件概率 P(A|B) 问的是：已经处在 B 里，A 的机会有多大？报价率之前，先把分母收缩到条件 B。

1,000 笔里有 400 笔冷饮；其中 120 笔兼买甜点。所以 P(甜点|冷饮) = 120/400 = 0.30——在冷饮细分里读，而不是只看全店甜点边缘。

The mechanics of bundling

The general multiplication rule chains events: P(A and B) = P(B) × P(A|B). Use it when several milestones must succeed in sequence.

Morning funnel: 40 percent order cold brew; given that, 30 percent add a croissant. Joint bundle rate = 0.40 × 0.30 = 0.12 — about 120 bundles per 1,000 customers. Multiplying raw margins alone is safe only after independence is proven.

捆绑漏斗的乘法机制

一般乘法法则把事件串起来：P(A 且 B) = P(B) × P(A|B)。多个里程碑必须依次成功时用它。

早市漏斗：40% 点冷萃；在此条件下 30% 加可颂。联合套餐率 = 0.40 × 0.30 = 0.12——约每 1,000 位顾客 120 份。只有证明相互独立后，才能直接把边缘概率相乘。

A probability tree maps multi-stage operations. Multiply along a branch for a path probability; add mutually exclusive tip paths for an event total.

Stitching the network together

The law of total probability weights each conditional rate by how much volume that source carries, then adds the pieces. A simple average of supplier defect rates ignores uneven share.

Weight each bakery by supply share: contributions 0.010 + 0.012 + 0.010 = 0.032. Network defect rate is 3.2 percent — the macro number executives can manage.

把网络风险缝成一个数

全概率定律按各来源的体量份额，给条件次品率加权再相加。对供应商次品率做简单平均，会忽略份额不均。

按供货份额加权：0.010 + 0.012 + 0.010 = 0.032。全网次品率是 3.2%——高管可以统筹的宏观数字。

贝叶斯法则把证据翻成信念：把先验基础率，与机器故障/正常时警报如何表现结合起来。

Bayes' rule flips evidence into belief: blend the prior base rate with how the alert behaves when the machine is broken versus healthy.

低频灾难陷阱

事件很罕见时，基础率谬误最伤人。即便筛查还不错，误报也可能远多于真报。

若 110 次标记里只有 10 次是真实欺诈，后验欺诈概率约 9.1%；其余 100 次是误报。把标记当证据而非铁证——响应要结合核实风险、顾客影响与批准的管控。

The rare disaster trap

The base-rate fallacy hits when the event is rare. Even a decent screen can flood you with false flags that outnumber true ones.

If 10 of 110 flags are genuine fraud, the posterior fraud probability is about 9.1 percent; the other 100 flags are false positives. Treat a flag as evidence, not proof — design the response with verified risk, customer impact, and approved controls.

videos.title: 用概率透视明天的商业不确定性（旁白：普通话 · 画面：English）
videos.description:
系列：STAT M02 · 咖啡连锁的商务概率 · 旁白：普通话 · 画面：English · 第 01/15 课
下一课：https://youtu.be/hG6ymHDkBLU
播放列表：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDpp78apMApg

用概率透视明天的商业不确定性

描述性指标可以说：A店平均卖出420杯，全网标准差是78杯。这些数字总结的是已经卖掉的杯子。它们改变不了明天。暴雨、断货或突然爆客来袭时，你怎么在危机到来前给风险定价？

商务概率用四大支柱作答：界定所有可能结果的全集、场景一变就更新胜率（条件）、从警报倒推真实故障（逆转）、用期望货币价值给赌注定价。

描述统计看后视镜。概率望向前挡风玻璃：把不确定性标在零到一的尺上，让管理者在未来展开前就能调配资源。一次不利结果不等于决策错了——评判你选的胜率，不要只看这一次掷骰。

商务概率基础 - 模块2 - 短片1（导论）
觉得有用的话，订阅下一集。

—— English ——

Seeing tomorrow through probability

Descriptive dials can say Shop A averaged 420 cups, with a network standard deviation of 78. Those numbers summarize what already sold. They cannot change tomorrow. When a storm, a supply halt, or a viral crowd hits, how do you price that risk before it arrives?

Business probability answers with four pillars: define the universe of possible outcomes, update odds when context changes (conditioning), diagnose true faults behind alerts (inversion), and price bets with expected monetary value.

Descriptive statistics looks in the rearview mirror. Probability looks through the windshield: it maps uncertainty onto a zero-to-one scale so managers can commit resources before the future unfolds. A bad outcome does not prove a bad decision — judge the odds you chose, not one roll alone.
